places.ai_summary: A historic bridge over the Arno River, famous for its shops and picturesque views.

places.place_tip: Explore the shops and enjoy the view of the Arno River.
places.address: Ponte Vecchio, Florence, Italy

places.ai_summary: The town hall of Florence, featuring a striking tower and an array of Renaissance art.

places.name: Piazza della Signoria
places.ai_summary: A vibrant square in front of Palazzo Vecchio, known for its statues and lively atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late evening.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the replica of Michelangelo's David.
places.address: Piazza della Signoria, Florence, Italy

places.ai_summary: Home to Michelangelo's David, this gallery is a must-visit for art lovers.
places.place_tip: Admire the original David statue and other masterpieces by Michelangelo.

places.ai_summary: A beautiful basilica known for its frescoes and as the burial place of Michelangelo and Galileo.
places.place_tip: Look for the tombs of famous Italians like Michelangelo and Galileo.
places.address: Piazza di Santa Croce, 16, 50122 Firenze FI, Italy

places.name: Boboli Gardens
places.ai_summary: A historic park with beautiful gardens, sculptures, and fountains, offering a great view of the city.
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for walking.
places.address: Piazza Pitti, 1, 50125 Firenze FI, Italy

places.name: Pitti Palace
places.ai_summary: A grand palace with impressive art collections, including works by Raphael and Titian.
places.place_tip: Don't miss the Palatine Gallery and the Royal Apartments.

attribution.title: Florence. Firenze.
attribution.author: http://www.geographicus.com/mm5/cartographers/sduk.txt
attribution.credit: This file was provided to Wikimedia Commons by Geographicus Rare Antique Maps, a specialist dealer in rare maps and other cartography of the 15th, 16th, 17th, 18th and 19th centuries, as part of a cooperation project.
attribution.description: This map is a steel plate engraving, dating to 1835 by the Society for the Diffusion of Useful Knowledge, S.D.U.K.  It represents the city of Florence or Firenze, Italy.  Depicts the old city of Firenze in considerable detail and give attention to most important streets, buildings and monuments.  Along the bottom of the map there appears drawings of the facades of 16 Florentine structures entitled A comparison of the principal buildings in Florence. Published for the Society for the Diffusion of Useful Knowledge, by Baldwin and Cradock of Paternoster Row, London, 1835.
